review_evidence: README identifies Lean-Oscar as an interface between Lean and the Oscar computer algebra system, directing users to test.lean for working examples.

Complete inspection of test.lean shows substantive definitions, examples and theorems exercising MRDI transport, matrix inversion, permutation-group membership, Rubik-group computations and finitely presented group reasoning; it is retained despite its test name.
Complete inspection of lakefile.lean found only Lake package setup, Mathlib dependency and Mrdi/Oscar library targets.

rules.content_invariant: The exact file contains only Lake package/dependency/library-target configuration; Oscar/MRDI interfaces, tactics and all formal examples/theorems remain in retained sources.
evidence: Complete inspection found only Lake DSL configuration and no owned interop definition, theorem, proof or tactic implementation.
